items.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 어휘의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices: She <u>wrapped</u> the cake in a box and put it on the table in the kitchen.
It had rooms that <u>celebrated</u> great people.
But I had a stomachache, so I <u>stayed</u> in bed.
A leather pilot jacket and goggles were <u>displayed</u>.
The box was <u>empty</u>, so I could see the cake in it.
items.explain: ⑤ 상자가 비어 있으면 케이크를 볼 수 없다. 원문: The box was open, so I could see the cake in it.
items.source: L5 본문 도입·Tom · L6 본문 도입·첫 번째 방 (⑤만 원문의 open을 empty로 바꿈)

items.stem: 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 단어로 적절한 것은?
items.box:
• Chocolate is ______ and delicious.
• He is so ______ to people.
items.explain: sweet: 달콤한 / 상냥한 (다의어).

items.stem: 우리말을 영어로 옮긴 것으로 적절하지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices:
그녀는 놀라서 방을 둘러보았다.
⇒ She looked around the room in surprise.

나는 정확한 시간은 모른다.
⇒ I don't know the exact time.

무엇보다도, 나는 초콜릿 케이크를 좋아하지 않는다.
⇒ Most of all, I don't like chocolate cake.

그녀는 그것을 집어 들었다.
⇒ She picked it up.

Emily는 Fabre가 30년 넘게 곤충에 관한 많은 책들을 썼다는 것을 알게 되었다.
⇒ Emily learned that Fabre wrote many books about insects for less than thirty years.
items.explain: ⑤ '~ 넘게, ~ 이상'은 more than ~. 원문: … for more than thirty years.
items.source: L6 본문 첫 번째 방·두 번째 방 · L5 본문 Carol (⑤만 원문의 more를 less로 바꿈)

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
items.box: I saw Tom coming ______ of the kitchen.
items.explain: come out of ~: ~에서 나오다. (I saw Tom coming out of the kitchen.)

lines: B: Oh! I lost my backpack!
G: I'm sorry to hear that. Where did you last see it?
B: Hmm.... I think I ____ⓐ____ it on the basketball court.
G: What does it look like?
B: It's a blue backpack with a star pattern on it.
G: Oh, let's go to the basketball court and look for it.

items.stem: 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은? (문장의 의미와 어법 모두 고려할 것)
items.explain: '어디에 두고 왔다'는 과거의 일 → left.

items.stem: 위 대화를 읽고 답변할 수 <u>없는</u> 내용의 질문은?
choices: 소년은 그것을 어디에 두고 왔다고 생각하는가?
그들은 그것을 찾으러 어디로 갈 것인가?
items.explain: 잃어버린 때는 대화에 나오지 않는다. ① 배낭 ② 농구 코트 ③ 별무늬 파란색 ⑤ 농구 코트.

lines: G: Mike, what are you listening to?
B: I'm listening to Beethoven. I'm interested in his music.
G: That sounds awesome!
B: I hope to make music like him in the future.
B:Boy / G:Girl

items.stem: 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
choices: I hope your dream comes true.
items.explain: 꿈을 말한 상대에게 꿈이 이루어지기를 바란다고 답한다.
items.source: L6 UC A-3 (선지는 모두 교과서 대화문 문장 그대로)

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Mike는 Beethoven에 관한 책을 읽고 있다.
Mike는 미래에 Beethoven처럼 음악을 만들고 싶어 한다.
items.explain: ① 음악을 듣고 있음 ③④ 언급 없음 ⑤ 듣는 사람은 Mike.

items.stem: 주어진 문장에 이어질 대화의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
G: I'm looking for my cat, Bori. She is missing.

(A) G: She has short and gray fur. She has blue eyes.
(B) B: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. What does she look like?
(C) G: Thanks!
(D) B: I'll help you. Let's look for your cat together.
items.explain: 고양이가 사라졌다 → (B) 유감·생김새 질문 → (A) 짧은 회색 털·파란 눈 → (D) 함께 찾아보자 → (C) 고마워.
items.source: L5 Wrap Up 1 (순서배열 보기로 문장 순서만 섞음)

lines: G: Hi, Kevin. What are you doing?
B: Well, I'm looking for my dog. I lost him in this park.
G: I'm sorry to hear that. ⓐ<u>What does he look like?</u>
B: He has a long body and short legs. Here's his picture.
G: Okay. Let's find your dog together.

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용으로 볼 때 두 사람이 대화 직후에 할 일로 가장 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: Let's find your dog together.

items.stem: 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 문맥상 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: What does ~ look like?: 생김새를 묻는 표현. 뒤에 긴 몸·짧은 다리로 답한다.

items.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
A: Hello, may I help you?
B: I lost my umbrella in this park.
A: I'm sorry to hear that. What does it look like?
B: It's yellow. Also, it has a flower pattern.
A: Okay. ______________
choices: I'll call you when we find it.
I hope your dream comes true.
items.explain: 분실물 신고를 받은 뒤 찾으면 연락하겠다는 말.

items.stem: 빈칸 ⓐ, ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 적절하게 짝 지어진 것은?
items.box:
• She will visit a museum ____ⓐ____ opened last month.
• I saw him ____ⓑ____ the street.
items.explain: ⓐ 선행사 a museum(사물) → which (학습지: She will visit a museum which opened last month.). ⓑ 지각동사 saw + 목적어 + 동사원형/현재분사 → crossing (학습지: I saw him cross the street.).
items.source: 학습지 p.15 Grammar Points 1 B-4 · p.16 Grammar Points 2 예문 (문장 그대로, 빈칸만)

items.stem: 글을 쓴 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box: There was a famous painting in the museum, but it disappeared. I saw four people leaving the museum. They were Ms. Smith, Ms. Green, Mr. Lee, and Mr. Roberts. One of them is the thief. I think the person who stole the painting is Ms. Green. The first clue is her beautiful long dress. She could hide the painting in her dress. The second clue is an earring on the floor. She was wearing the same earring on her right ear. What's your guess?
choices: 글쓴이가 Ms. Green을 도둑이라고 생각하는 이유를 설명하려고
잃어버린 귀걸이를 찾는 데 도움을 요청하려고
items.explain: 두 가지 단서를 들어 Green 씨가 도둑이라고 추측하는 글.

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box: Hi, my name is Ruby. I want to talk about my grandfather. He is so wise that he always has good advice. When I made some mistakes on a test, he told me to learn from the mistakes. After that, I didn't make the same mistakes. I'm ______ by his wisdom. I hope to be a wise person like him. He is my role model.
items.explain: be guided by ~: ~에 의해 인도되다. 할아버지의 지혜를 따른다는 뜻.

items.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아 <u>어색한</u> 곳은?
items.box: Jane Goodall is an animal scientist. ⓐ<u>She is the first person to study chimpanzees in the wild.</u> ⓑ<u>She also wrote a book about her life and her love for chimpanzees.</u> ⓒ<u>Like Jane Goodall, I'm very interested in animal behavior.</u> ⓓ<u>I'm trying to lose weight these days.</u> ⓔ<u>I want to study animals in the wild and help them, too.</u>
items.explain: Jane Goodall을 소개하는 글에 살을 빼려고 한다는 ⓓ(L5 본문 Carol의 말)는 흐름에 맞지 않는다.
items.source: L6 UC C-1 + L6 UC C 문장 (ⓓ는 L5 본문 문장을 일부러 끼워 넣음)

items.stem: 우리말 뜻과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열할 때 <u>네 번째</u>에 오는 단어는?
items.box:
Steve는 너무 천천히 걸어서 나는 그를 기다려야 했다.
( I, slowly, wait, that, so, had to, Steve walked, for him )
items.explain: Steve walked so slowly that I had to wait for him. → 네 번째 slowly.

items.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices: The classroom is cleaned by them.
My bike was stolen last week.
The story was so funny that we laughed a lot.
This laptop was fixed by her.
Lucy is love by the children.
items.explain: ⑤ 수동태는 be동사 + 과거분사 → is loved.
items.source: 선생님 제작 문장 · 학습지 L6 Grammar Points 1(수동태) · Grammar Points 2(so ~ that)

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 말끼리 짝 지어진 것은?
items.explain: 사역동사 made·had·let은 목적격 보어로 동사원형(clean)을 쓴다. want·tell은 to부정사가 필요하다.
items.source: 선생님 제작 문장 · 사역동사 확장(지침: 지각동사 → 사역동사까지)

items.stem: 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 단어는? (대소문자 구별하지 않음)
items.box:
Special Invitation
Dear Emily,
Welcome to the Historia Museum! Come and see our ______ rooms. Each room will take you on an ______ journey back in time.
Brave ______
Great Adventurer
Powerful Painter
Insect ______
When: October 1st ― 30th
Where: Historia Museum in Dream City
items.explain: our special rooms / an amazing journey / Brave Pilot / Insect Lover. empty는 들어갈 곳이 없다.

lines: Finally, Ms. Jones met Tom, the youngest son. "Tom, you like your mom's cake, right?"
"Yeah, I like it." "Actually, I ⓐ<u>smelled</u> Mom baking a cake in the morning." "But I had a stomachache, so I stayed in bed."
"Did you go to the kitchen?"
"Yes, I went to the kitchen to take some ____ⓑ____ at about 11:30." "The box was open, so I could see the cake in it." "Then I closed the box."
Ms. Jones smiled and said, "The person who lied ate the cake."

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 영영풀이로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: to notice something by using your nose
to cook something in an oven
to put paper or cloth over something to cover it
to deliberately tell someone something that is not true
to communicate with someone by phone, email, or other methods
items.explain: smell: to notice something by using your nose. (② bake ③ wrap ④ lie ⑤ contact)
items.source: L5 본문 Tom · L5 어휘 영영풀이 (풀이 문장 그대로)

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 배가 아파서 약을 먹으러 주방에 갔다. take medicine: 약을 먹다.

lines: Next, Ms. Jones talked to Carol, the daughter. She stayed home all morning. Ms. Jones asked, "What were you doing between 11 and 12?"

"I was reading a detective novel in the living room." "I went to the kitchen to drink some water and found the box on the table." "But I couldn't see the cake inside the box." "You know, I'm trying to ____ⓐ____ these days." "So, I don't eat any dessert." "Most of all, I don't like chocolate cake." "Too much sugar and butter in it."
"When did you go to the kitchen?"
"I don't know the exact time, but I saw Tom coming out of the kitchen."

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 그래서 디저트를 먹지 않는다 → 살을 빼려고(lose weight).

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Carol은 11시와 12시 사이에 주방에서 책을 읽고 있었다.
Carol은 Harry가 주방에서 나오는 것을 보았다.
items.explain: ② 거실 ③ 볼 수 없었다 ④ 좋아하지 않는다 ⑤ Tom.

items.stem: 다음 문장 (A)~(E)에 대해 바르게 설명한 사람만을 <보기>에서 <u>모두</u> 고른 것은?
items.box:
(A) She's an animal scientist (A)<u>who</u> studied chimpanzees for many years.
(B) Lucy (B)<u>is loved</u> by the children.
(C) I felt the wind (C)<u>blowing</u> on my face.
(D) Mom called Ms. Jones to find the person (D)<u>which</u> ate the cake.
(E) He practiced (E)<u>so</u> hard <u>that</u> he could speak English very well.

<보기>
ⓐ 수연 : (A)는 선행사 an animal scientist가 사람이니까 who를 쓴 게 맞아.
ⓑ 예지 : (B)는 주어가 Lucy니까 능동태 loves로 고쳐야 해.
ⓒ 민수 : (C)는 지각동사 felt의 목적격 보어로 진행 중인 동작을 나타내는 현재분사를 쓴 거라 맞아.
ⓓ 지현 : (D)는 선행사 the person이 사람이니까 who나 that으로 고쳐야 해.
items.explain: (A) 선행사 an animal scientist(사람) → who ○. (B) Lucy가 사랑받는 것 → is loved 수동태 ○(예지 ✗). (C) 지각동사 felt + 현재분사 blowing ○. (D) 선행사 the person(사람) → who/that (본문 원문: the person who ate the cake). (E) so ~ that ○.
items.source: L6 UC C · 학습지 p.21 예문 · p.16 A-4 · L5 본문 도입(who를 which로 바꿈) · 학습지 p.25 예문
